subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of leading a warm-up or activity segment for others in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe officiating basics: rules, positioning, and consistent judgement using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply giving feedback about performance and never about bodies in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving managing a disagreement during activity; correct it and explain why.
Connect organizing an activity that includes mixed abilities by design with reflecting on leadership honestly and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Plan and lead one activity segment for at least one other person, or produce a complete leadership plan with a self-run rehearsal if no other participants are available, then evaluate it against inclusion and safety criteria.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Cooperation, Leadership, and Officiating?
